section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the psychometric properties of an Arabic translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) with college-aged women from the United Arab Emirates (n = 256). The study found that BAS-2 scores were positively correlated with body image and body pride, but not with BMI, suggesting the Arabic BAS-2 is a psychometrically sound measure for cross-cultural body image research.
